one_sentence_summary: Synthetic fixture note: Fixed-threshold benchmark for agent covert-channel detection discusses agent covert-channel detection and covert-signal false alarm rate.
core_claims: agent covert-channel detection can be evaluated with explicit covert-signal false alarm rate controls.
main_results: Synthetic result: communication trace monitor is evaluated with covert-signal false alarm rate.

stated_limitations: Deployment shift remains unresolved for agent covert-channel detection.
unstated_limitations: The fixture cannot establish real-world validity for AI agent covert channels.
what_it_cannot_answer: Whether real literature already solves AI agent covert channels.
